title: Perp margin checks fail open when CAP_MARGIN_CHECK is absent, allowing insolvent trades if the Risk provider is not registered
root_cause: PositionManager._marginCheck() falls back to NullMarginCheck (no-op) when capabilityProvider(CAP_MARGIN_CHECK)==0, and the TYPE_TRADE plugin OrderbookPlugin declares no required capabilities (BasePlugin default empty), so registerPlugin accepts the trading surface with no margin provider — a perp deployment can run with maintenance-margin enforcement silently disabled (fail-open).
attacker_entrypoint: ordinary user-signed TYPE_TRADE relayed through the txBatcher, on a perp deployment with CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider absent (pre-wiring window or profile that omits it)
attacker_capabilities: submit a normal signed limit-order trade (no privilege); the missing-provider state is a deployment precondition, not an attacker action
privilege_required: none for the attack action (a normal user trade); the missing-provider state is a deployment precondition
out_of_scope_risks: OUT OF SCOPE if the program treats the missing-provider state as pure owner misconfiguration (same not-wired condition that put F-2 out of scope)

severity_justification.worst_case: HIGH if an in-scope perp deployment can reach CAP_MARGIN_CHECK==0 while trading is live (deploy/upgrade window or a perp profile omitting the provider): ordinary user trades create bad debt with no margin enforcement.
severity_justification.realistic_case: MEDIUM fail-open design defect: no on-chain assertion that a margin provider exists for margin-gated txTypes, and no event when checks are off.
severity_justification.out_of_scope_case: If only owner-misconfiguration (forgetting/unregistering Risk) reaches the state and the program excludes admin misconfig.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: TipRun contest (tiprun-contracts-main @ d5d4d2a); official scope list not bundled with PoC package.

call_trace: (1) txTypeToPlugin(TYPE_TRADE).requiredCapabilities().length == 0 -> registerPlugin accepts trading with no CAP_MARGIN_CHECK provider
(2) negative control with Risk wired: user-signed TYPE_TRADE via txBatcher->MTP->OrderbookPlugin->PositionManager.updatePosition REVERTS 'PM: risk inc'
(3) provider absent (deployment state): identical user-signed TYPE_TRADE ACCEPTED -> _marginCheck() no-op
(3) result: B short 5000 / collateral 5001, Risk view value 4.3e9 vs risk 9.2e22 -> far below maintenance margin (bad debt)

state_transition.before: Risk provider wired -> the user trade is rejected (PM: risk inc)
state_transition.after: provider absent -> identical user trade accepted; account at risk 9.2e22 vs value 4.3e9 (risk >> value*FXP)

asset_delta: An under-margin position (bad debt) is created via a normal user trade. PoC proves position OPENING only; no withdrawal/exfiltration path is claimed.
false_positive_risks: no impact on spot/predict (NullMarginCheck intended); requires a perp profile expected to have the margin engine
invalidating_conditions: target deployment is spot/predict (no maintenance margin) — fallback is correct
operator guarantees CAP_MARGIN_CHECK is always wired on perp profiles

defense_analysis.why_it_fails: OrderbookPlugin (TYPE_TRADE) declares no required capabilities (proven: requiredCapabilities().length==0), so registration never enforces a margin provider
with the provider wired the same user trade is correctly rejected ('PM: risk inc') — the finding is precisely the fail-OPEN when it is absent

assumptions: the missing-provider state (CAP_MARGIN_CHECK absent while trading is live) is reachable/in-scope in the target deployment
triager_summary: Perp margin checks fail open: _marginCheck() returns a no-op when CAP_MARGIN_CHECK is absent and the TYPE_TRADE plugin requires no capability. Proven via the real user path: with Risk wired a normal trade reverts 'PM: risk inc'; with it absent the identical trade is accepted, leaving the account far below maintenance margin. Severity Medium (High only if the missing-provider state is in-scope reachable; OOS if pure owner misconfig). PoC proves position opening, not exfiltration.

cvss.aspect: Fail-open margin check; user trade creates bad debt when the provider is absent
cvss.severity: High (conditional on the missing-provider state being reachable)
